name: image-cropper
title: Image Cropper
description: An image editor with a draggable, resizable crop region, aspect-ratio lock, zoom, rotation and flip.
usageSnippet:
static const imageUrl = "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1494790108377-be9c29b29330?w=800";

<ImageCropper src=imageUrl alt="Photo to crop"/>

props.name: alt
props.description: Accessible description of the image being cropped.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description:
The aspect ratio to maintain for the crop area (width / height).
For example, an aspect ratio of 16 / 9 will maintain a width to height ratio of 16:9.
If not provided, the crop area can be freely resized.

props.name: cropShape
props.description: The shape of the crop area.

props.name: defaultFlip
props.description: The initial flip state to apply to the image.

props.name: defaultRotation
props.description: The initial rotation to apply to the image in degrees.

props.name: defaultZoom
props.description: The initial zoom factor to apply to the image.

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: fixedCropArea
props.description: Whether the crop area is fixed in size and position.

props.name: flip
props.description: The controlled flip state of the image.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: hideGrid
props.description: Hide the rule-of-thirds grid drawn inside the crop selection.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the image cropper elements

props.name: initialCrop
props.description:
The initial rectangle of the crop area.
If not provided, a smart default will be computed based on viewport size and aspect ratio.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: The maximum height of the crop area

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: The maximum width of the crop area

props.name: maxZoom
props.description: The maximum zoom factor allowed.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: The minimum height of the crop area

props.name: minWidth
props.description: The minimum width of the crop area

props.name: minZoom
props.description: The minimum zoom factor allowed.

props.name: nudgeStep
props.description: The base nudge step for keyboard arrow keys (in pixels).

props.name: nudgeStepCtrl
props.description: The nudge step when Ctrl/Cmd key is held (in pixels).

props.name: nudgeStepShift
props.description: The nudge step when Shift key is held (in pixels).

props.name: rotation
props.description: The controlled rotation of the image in degrees (0 - 360).

props.name: src
props.description: Source of the image to crop.

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identify accessibility elements and their states.

props.name: zoom
props.description: The controlled zoom level of the image.

props.name: zoomSensitivity
props.description: Controls how responsive pinch-to-zoom is.

props.name: zoomStep
props.description: The amount of zoom applied per wheel step.

events.name: cropChange
events.description: Sugar for onCropChange — receives the plain crop rect.

events.name: flipChange
events.description: Sugar for onFlipChange — receives the plain flip state.

events.name: onCropChange
events.description: Callback fired when the crop area changes.

events.name: onFlipChange
events.description: Callback fired when the flip state changes.

events.name: onRotationChange
events.description: Callback fired when the rotation changes.

events.name: onZoomChange
events.description: Callback fired when the zoom level changes.

events.name: rotationChange
events.description: Sugar for onRotationChange — receives the plain rotation in degrees.

events.name: zoomChange
events.description: Sugar for onZoomChange — receives the plain zoom, enables `zoom:=state`.

examples.title: Default
examples.description: A freely resizable crop region with the rule-of-thirds grid shown.

examples.title: Circle crop, locked 1:1
examples.source:
import ImageCropper from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/image-cropper/image-cropper.marko";

static const SAMPLE_IMAGE =
  "data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='640' height='480' viewBox='0 0 640 480'%3E%3Cdefs%3E%3ClinearGradient id='g' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'%3E%3Cstop offset='0' stop-color='%23f59e0b'/%3E%3Cstop offset='0.5' stop-color='%23ec4899'/%3E%3Cstop offset='1' stop-color='%236366f1'/%3E%3C/linearGradient%3E%3C/defs%3E%3Crect width='640' height='480' fill='url(%23g)'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='160' cy='130' r='70' fill='%23fef3c7' opacity='0.9'/%3E%3Cpath d='M0 480 L180 260 L320 400 L470 210 L640 480 Z' fill='%23134e4a' opacity='0.75'/%3E%3Cpath d='M0 480 L140 330 L300 480 Z' fill='%23042f2e' opacity='0.7'/%3E%3Cg fill='%23ffffff' opacity='0.85'%3E%3Crect x='30' y='30' width='60' height='4'/%3E%3Crect x='30' y='30' width='4' height='60'/%3E%3Crect x='550' y='446' width='60' height='4'/%3E%3Crect x='606' y='390' width='4' height='60'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E";

<ImageCropper
  class="max-w-md h-72"
  src=SAMPLE_IMAGE
  alt="Sample landscape"
  aspectRatio=1
  cropShape="circle"
  hideGrid
  initialCrop={ x: 90, y: 40, width: 180, height: 180 }
/>
examples.description: Pass `aspectRatio` to lock the crop region's proportions, and `cropShape="circle"` for an avatar-style mask.

examples.title: Fixed crop area
examples.source:
import ImageCropper from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/image-cropper/image-cropper.marko";

static const SAMPLE_IMAGE =
  "data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='640' height='480' viewBox='0 0 640 480'%3E%3Cdefs%3E%3ClinearGradient id='g' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'%3E%3Cstop offset='0' stop-color='%23f59e0b'/%3E%3Cstop offset='0.5' stop-color='%23ec4899'/%3E%3Cstop offset='1' stop-color='%236366f1'/%3E%3C/linearGradient%3E%3C/defs%3E%3Crect width='640' height='480' fill='url(%23g)'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='160' cy='130' r='70' fill='%23fef3c7' opacity='0.9'/%3E%3Cpath d='M0 480 L180 260 L320 400 L470 210 L640 480 Z' fill='%23134e4a' opacity='0.75'/%3E%3Cpath d='M0 480 L140 330 L300 480 Z' fill='%23042f2e' opacity='0.7'/%3E%3Cg fill='%23ffffff' opacity='0.85'%3E%3Crect x='30' y='30' width='60' height='4'/%3E%3Crect x='30' y='30' width='4' height='60'/%3E%3Crect x='550' y='446' width='60' height='4'/%3E%3Crect x='606' y='390' width='4' height='60'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E";

<ImageCropper
  class="max-w-md h-72"
  src=SAMPLE_IMAGE
  alt="Sample landscape"
  fixedCropArea
  hideGrid
  initialCrop={ x: 80, y: 50, width: 240, height: 160 }
/>
examples.description: `fixedCropArea` pins the selection's size and position — the user can only pan and zoom the image underneath it.

examples.title: Controlled zoom and rotation
examples.source:
import ImageCropper from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/image-cropper/image-cropper.marko"; static const SAMPLE_IMAGE = "data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='640' height='480' viewBox='0 0 640 480'%3E%3Cdefs%3E%3ClinearGradient id='g' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'%3E%3Cstop offset='0' stop-color='%23f59e0b'/%3E%3Cstop offset='0.5' stop-color='%23ec4899'/%3E%3Cstop offset='1' stop-color='%236366f1'/%3E%3C/linearGradient%3E%3C/defs%3E%3Crect width='640' height='480' fill='url(%23g)'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='160' cy='130' r='70' fill='%23fef3c7' opacity='0.9'/%3E%3Cpath d='M0 480 L180 260 L320 400 L470 210 L640 480 Z' fill='%23134e4a' opacity='0.75'/%3E%3Cpath d='M0 480 L140 330 L300 480 Z' fill='%23042f2e' opacity='0.7'/%3E%3Cg fill='%23ffffff' opacity='0.85'%3E%3Crect x='30' y='30' width='60' height='4'/%3E%3Crect x='30' y='30' width='4' height='60'/%3E%3Crect x='550' y='446' width='60' height='4'/%3E%3Crect x='606' y='390' width='4' height='60'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E"; static const BUTTON_CLASS = "border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground inline-flex h-8 items-center rounded-md border px-3 text-sm font-medium transition-colors";

Zoom: ${zoom.toFixed(2)} · Rotation: ${rotation}°
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: `zoom` and `rotation` props without change handlers never move. Pair them with `zoomChange` and `rotationChange`, or use Marko's bind shorthand `zoom:=state`.
